_comment: Card operations, expressed as proRFL.dll calls. Each arg is [kind, value]:
['i', int-or-placeholder]  input int,  ['s', str-or-placeholder]  input string,
Placeholders use Python format syntax and may carry a format spec, e.g. {start:%y%m%d%H%M}.
{port} is filled from the encoder (1 = Pro HID D801-M1, 0 = legacy).
'calibrated': false means the argument order/format was inferred from disassembly and has
NOT been confirmed on a real encoder. The gateway refuses those operations until an admin
verifies them and marks them calibrated (PATCH /v1/templates/{name}) - see docs/CALIBRATION.md.
Changes made through the API are stored in the database and override this file.

issue_guest.note: 10 args / stdcall are certain; args 7-9 are strings. co_id 79375 = 0x1360F = dlsCoID in System.ini; its low 16 bits (360F) appear in every card. Order of the other ints, the time format and arg 9 are inferred.

erase_card.note: 3 args / stdcall are certain; meaning of args 2-3 is inferred.

issue_master.note: Arg count/types from disassembly are certain; order and formats are inferred - calibrate on hardware.
